scenes.title: the bend

scenes.narration: This happens because light slows down entering water, and that change in speed is what bends its path.

scenes.title: why it bends

scenes.narration: The ratio of sine of the incidence angle to sine of the refraction angle stays fixed for a given pair of media, a value called the refractive index.
